name: v1.0-arxiv — Paper artefacts (arXiv:2608.00585)
body:
Code, data splits, per-question traces and analysis scripts for
**Verification Without Sufficiency: Per-Chunk Filtering Fails on Multi-Hop RAG,
and Decomposition Repairs It** — arXiv:2608.00585

This tag is the frozen state that produced the paper. Every number in every
table is generated by a script reading the released traces.

## What the paper finds

Per-chunk verification assumes each retrieved chunk is a sufficient premise for
the answer. Multi-hop questions are built so that none is, and the paragraph
carrying the answer is the one the question does not name.

| Signal | SQuAD (1-hop) | HotpotQA | 2Wiki | MuSiQue |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| embedding cosine | 0.933 | 0.887 | 0.807 | 0.762 |
| NLI entailment | 0.951 | 0.643 | 0.523 | 0.560 |

End to end, per-chunk gating is significantly worse than not filtering at all on
all three multi-hop datasets, and its penalty grows with generator capability
(−4.6 EM at 0.5B, −19.4 at 3B on HotpotQA).

Conditioning the hypothesis on the decomposed sub-question instead of the
original query lifts entailment on a later hop from 0.546 (chance) to 0.840,
a paired lift of +0.355 [0.331, 0.382].

## Contents

- `paper/` — the paper and its LaTeX source
- `src/triver_core.py` — the three signals, HRR algebra, metrics, statistics
- `modal/` — one file per experiment stage, 15 experiments total
- `splits/` — exact question identifiers, seed 1337
- `results/analysis/` — every aggregate a table or figure reads
- `traces/` — per-question JSONL for every configuration
- `tests/test_core.py` — 18 checks, no GPU, runs in ten seconds

## Reproducing

Requires a Modal account and about $24 of credit. Full pipeline is roughly five
hours of wall clock, most of it unattended. See `REPRODUCE.md`.
